_desc: Blog ('Blogs' section) settings. Posts are .mdx files in this folder (filename = URL slug). Frontmatter: title, date (YYYY-MM-DD), tags [1-3], optional description/image/draft/sourceUrl (original platform link, e.g. LinkedIn). A post with an EMPTY body renders as 'Coming Soon' until you write it. Files starting with '_' are ignored.

_fields.subtitle: Page subtitle. Reference: 'Thoughts, tutorials, and insights on engineering and programming.'
_fields.categoriesOrder: Optional: preferred order for filter chips, e.g. ['Personal', 'AI', 'Next.js']. [] = order by count (reference behavior).
_fields.frontmatter: Each .mdx file must start with: --- / title / description / date (YYYY-MM-DD) / tags [1-3] / image (optional, under /images/blog/) / draft (optional, true hides the post) / ---
